## Design

### 2026-10-15 – ## Week 2 – Entry 1: Designing the Electrotrack track

**2.78h**

## Week 2 – Entry 1: Designing the Electrotrack track

This session focused on the mechanical design for Electrotrack. I used Onshape to model the first version of the track, coil formers and infrared sensor mounts, then brought the parts together in an assembly.

### Track segments

![track](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/D1H5wjMaoqfsZfeTslugwWB4nIQcEzNR/87ab374f10d55ab79cc84fdd5368b8a731cf0ab57c5ad68d3e57b8cbeb05d9e9.png)
I modelled a curved guide segment with an open channel for the steel ball. Repeating the segment in the assembly creates the circular track.

### Coil  formers
![coil](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/D1H5wjMaoqfsZfeTslugwWB4nIQcEzNR/78600c51195e9c5227296292100ad3fec2d9f581509bf5b88e8934cfaeb007fb.png)
I designed a separate part
 for winding the copper wire. It has a central opening for the track and flanges on both sides to contain the winding.

### IR sensor mounts

![IR](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/D1H5wjMaoqfsZfeTslugwWB4nIQcEzNR/508ae3a262e1d6d6ed9c277b28301782257b3a01bdc71472ef23b883866c0e95.png)
I also modelled a separate sensor mount with openings intended for the infrared emitter and receiver. These mounts will hold the sensors used to detect the ball's position.

### Assembly and current progress

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/D1H5wjMaoqfsZfeTslugwWB4nIQcEzNR/63a9c5abe50bc33a5409225811543fb4e254fca330fc88d7d4b2a772d9a18ab7.png)
I assembled the track segments, four coil formers and sensor mounts to see how the parts fit together in CAD. This gave me the first overall view of the mechanical design.

The model is still a work in progress. Nothing has been printed or physically tested yet

### Next steps
- Finish the remaining CAD details.
- Check dimensions and clearances between the parts.
- Make test prints to check the fit before printing the full track.
